paragraphs.text:
The room is silent. You feel about for the light switch. You 
find it, and gently press it on. Oops! It’s Mrs. Harding’s room! 
What a mistake! You see her turn and rise from the bedclothes, 
her frightened face screaming. As the scream pierces your 
ears, you hear the boarders begin to stir. The residents are 
coming! But what’s focusing your attention is the shotgun 
Mrs. Harding is reaching for. You’d better run!
To escape, go to any Arkham Location.  
(52)
